text: VBET is a brand of the SoftConstruct group, founded in 2003 by Vigen and Vahe Badalyan; UK filings for VBET's UK entity (company 10392319) name both Badalyan brothers (born January 1975, resident in Armenia) as persons with significant control, each with more than 25% but not more than 50% of shares.
